name: neruva-langgraph
summary: Drop-in LangGraph integration for Neruva agent memory + reasoning substrate. v0.2.0 adds AUTO-PILOT: NeruvaAutoPilot (classify intent + reflect + extract via your LLM) + classify_intent_node / reflect_node factories for drop-in graph wiring. Plus NeruvaCheckpointSaver (BaseCheckpointSaver) + NeruvaContextStore (BaseStore) for graph state persistence. Substrate stays $0/call (pattern-C). Deterministic from seed. Works with every LangGraph StateGraph.
